values.meaning: root duration on champions hit by a Chomper
time until Chompers arm after landing
time until Chompers explode on their own

mechanics.claim: Chompers explode either on contact with an enemy champion or after a timer, dealing damage to nearby enemies either way.
mechanics.quote: landing after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: A Chomper only roots/knocks down the first enemy champion it hits; other champions are unaffected by that Chomper.
mechanics.quote: Enemy champions can be affected by only one ''Chomper''.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not block the explosion's damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} does not negate the explosion.
